Elements matching CSS id selector are excluded entirely

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<body><div id="ad-container">Buy stuff</div><p>Article text</p></body>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(exclude_selectors: ['#ad-container']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
